tei:div.tei:p: gter mdzod/ (kha)pa la/ lo rgyus de ldan gyi gdams pa'i zab chos ji ltar bzhugs pa'i dkar chag dang 'brel smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa'i brgyud yig dngos grub sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde'u mig la ldeb/ 262 1-524 si tu rin po che pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal pos kha skong brgyud rim dang 'brel bar gter mdzod rtogs brjod ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas gsar bris la ldeb/ 16 525-555 dil mkhyen rin po che maṅga la shrī bhū tis rin gter zhal skong zhus pa rnams kyi brgyud yig yid ches dad pa'i gsos sman la ldeb/ 6 557-568 smin grol lag len dang bcas bsham bya ba'i tshul mthong bas go 'byed la ldeb/ 110 569-787 dil mkhyen rin po ches rin gter zhal skong skor gyi bcas bsham la ldeb/ 4 789-785 las 'phro gter brgyud rnam bshad nyung gsal ngo mtshar rgya mtsho rdo grub chen rin po che 'jig med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung la ldeb/ 31 797-858 bcas bzhugs/// /
